name: pi-bring-your-own-sandbox
description: A provider-neutral sandbox framework for Pi extensions

scripts.build: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -b tsconfig.build.json --force && node --input-type=module -e "import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'; import { computeProtocolBuild } from './dist/compute-protocol-build.js'; writeFileSync('dist/protocol-build.json', JSON.stringify(computeProtocolBuild()) + '\n')"
scripts.test:integration: pnpm build && vitest run src/*integration.test.ts src/user-shell-rpc.test.ts
